  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS ckd_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (443612,443611)
  )
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id,
         CASE WHEN de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (970250,1309799,991382,904542)) THEN 'Potassium-sparing diuretic'
              WHEN de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (956874,932745,942350,974166,1395058,907013,978555,992590)) THEN 'Potassium-wasting diuretic'
         END AS exposure_class,
         de.drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN ckd c ON c.person_id = de.person_id AND de.drug_exposure_start_date >= c.ckd_date
  WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (970250,1309799,991382,904542,956874,932745,942350,974166,1395058,907013,978555,992590)
  )
),
index_events AS (
  SELECT person_id, exposure_class, MIN(index_date) AS index_date
  FROM exposures
  WHERE exposure_class IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY person_id, exposure_class
),
hyper_dx AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT condition_concept_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (434610,4185833,4236458,4029592,4183002,4201725))
),
acid_dx AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT condition_concept_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (435517,4245042,4261800,1340398,4093780,4006308))
),
outcomes AS (
  SELECT ie.person_id, ie.exposure_class, ie.index_date,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
           WHERE co.person_id=ie.person_id AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT condition_concept_id FROM hyper_dx)
             AND co.condition_start_date BETWEEN ie.index_date AND DATEADD(day,180,ie.index_date)
         ) OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM omop.measurement m
           WHERE m.person_id=ie.person_id AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (3023103,46235078,3005456,3041354,3043409)
             AND m.value_as_number >= 5.5
             AND m.measurement_date BETWEEN ie.index_date AND DATEADD(day,180,ie.index_date)
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hyperkalemia_6mo,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
           WHERE co.person_id=ie.person_id AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT condition_concept_id FROM acid_dx)
             AND co.condition_start_date BETWEEN ie.index_date AND DATEADD(day,180,ie.index_date)
         ) OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM omop.measurement m
           WHERE m.person_id=ie.person_id AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (3016293,3015632,46235079,3006576,3009609,3009293,3027273)
             AND m.value_as_number < 22
             AND m.measurement_date BETWEEN ie.index_date AND DATEADD(day,180,ie.index_date)
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS acidosis_6mo
  FROM index_events ie
)
SELECT exposure_class,
       COUNT(*) AS exposed_persons,
       SUM(hyperkalemia_6mo) AS hyperkalemia_events_6mo,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(hyperkalemia_6mo)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS hyperkalemia_rate_pct,
       SUM(acidosis_6mo) AS acidosis_events_6mo,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(acidosis_6mo)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS acidosis_rate_pct
FROM outcomes
GROUP BY exposure_class
ORDER BY exposure_class;
